name: Lumina Supabase
description: Supabase tools for Lumina: read and write rows through PostgREST, plus DDL and project lifecycle through the Management API.

envPath.description: Absolute path to the .env shared with the rest of I24D.

schema.description: PostgREST schema exposed to the data tools.

maxRows.description: Hard cap on rows returned by lumina_supabase_query.

allowWrites.description: Enable lumina_supabase_mutate. Falls back to LUMINA_SUPABASE_ALLOW_WRITES when unset.

adminEnabled.description: Opt-in: register the Management API tools (DDL and project restore). The token they use is account-scoped. Enable explicitly when needed.

adminEnabled.label: Enable admin tools
adminEnabled.help: Allows CREATE/ALTER/DROP and restoring a paused project. Uses SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN, which reaches every project in the account. Off by default — enable explicitly.
